prediction_protocol: sigmoid; per-image min-max at model resolution; bilinear resize to original mask; mask>0

metric_protocol_details.aggregation: equal weight per image within each dataset; E/Fbeta mean and max taken AFTER averaging threshold curves across images
metric_protocol_details.input: saved uint8 probability map: floor(255 * resized prediction); library prepare_data maps nonconstant uint8 maps to [0,1], constant maps divided by 255; GT is input mask>0

Fbeta.threshold_curve: 256 integer thresholds [0,255], >= comparison after library float-to-uint8 conversion
Fbeta.empty_masks: unaltered PySODMetrics FmeasureV2 conventions (zero denominator -> zero score)

binary_empty_masks.overlap: IoU, Dice/F1 and BoundaryIoU are 1 when both masks are empty; 0 when only one is empty
binary_empty_masks.precision: no predicted foreground -> 1 if GT also empty, otherwise 0
binary_empty_masks.BER: 0.5 * (FNR + FPR), range [0,1]; an absent GT class contributes zero error

boundary.operation: inner boundary from 3x3 erosion repeated radius times; zero padding includes image borders
boundary.aggregation: image macro mean; semantic foreground mask, not COCO instance AP

metric_protocol_details.per_image_maxima: per-image E_max/Fbeta_max are diagnostic; their mean is NOT dataset E_max/Fbeta_max

geometry_protocol.ground_truth: original bytes and resolution; no crop, resize or sample exclusion
geometry_protocol.alignment: full-image normalized coordinates; registration is not verified

protocol.ground_truth: original bytes and resolution; no crop, resize or sample exclusion
protocol.alignment: full-image normalized coordinates; registration is not verified
